e.title: MIGA（世界银行集团）：政治风险担保产品全集、担保项目库与年报
e.title_en: MIGA (World Bank Group): the full political-risk guarantee product set, a guarantee/project database and annual reports
e.title_hk: MIGA（世界銀行集團）：政治風險擔保產品全集、擔保項目庫與年報
e.summary: 世界银行集团多边投资担保机构：提供政治风险担保（违约、汇兑限制、战争与内乱等）、贸易融资担保与信用担保（含「不履行公共债务」）全系列产品，设担保项目库与年报
e.summary_en: The World Bank Group’s multilateral investment guarantee agency: it offers a full product set of political risk guarantees (breach of contract, currency inconvertibility, war and civil disturbances), trade finance guarantees and credit guarantees (including non-honoring of public debt), with a guarantees/projects database and annual reports
e.summary_hk: 世界銀行集團多邊投資擔保機構：提供政治風險擔保（違約、匯兌限制、戰爭與內亂等）、貿易融資擔保與信用擔保（含「不履行公共債務」）全系列產品，設擔保項目庫與年報
e.body:
**MIGA（Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency，多边投资担保机构）** 是**世界银行集团成员**，站点标题实测为 **「World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA」**。本条目是**第 307、308 两轮明确记账后兑现的主条**，补的是**「政治风险与主权信用风险的实际承保方」这一形态**——**实测池内「政治风险」在标题与摘要层面为 0**（池内最接近的是 307 轮刚收的 [[berne-union]]，**但那是行业组织与统计，不是承保机构**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「All Guarantees（全部担保）」页 `/all-guarantees` 实测 109.2KB，标题「All Guarantees | World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA」**；⭐ **「Non-honoring of Public Debt（不履行公共债务）」产品页 `/product/non-honoring-public-debt` 实测 93.3KB**；**「Annual Reports」页 `/annual-reports` 实测 89.0KB**；首页实测 106.2KB。**导航逐字实测揭示的完整产品分类**：**POLITICAL RISK GUARANTEES（政治风险担保）** 下含 **Breach of Contract（违约）**、**Currency Inconvertibility and Transfer Restriction（汇兑不可兑换与转移限制）**、**Capital Optimization（资本优化）**、⭐ **War and Civil Disturbances（战争与内乱）**、**Project-Based Loan Guarantees for Private Sector Borrowers**、**Project-Based Payment Guarantee for the Private Sector**；**TRADE FINANCE GUARANTEES（贸易融资担保）** 下含 **Letter of Credit Confirmation（信用证保兑）** 与 **Trade Loans**；**CREDIT GUARANTEES（信用担保）** 下含 ⭐ **Non-honoring of Public Debt（不履行公共债务）**、**Partial/Full Credit Guarantees for Loan**、**Partial Credit Guarantees for Bonds**、**Unfunded Risk Participation**、**Risk-Sharing Facility**、**Significant Risk Transfer**。**站点结构实测**另含 **About（含 Reports and Resources、History、MIGA Convention）**、**Partnerships（DFIs and MDBs、Trust Fund Facilities、Government Partnerships、Global Platforms & Initiatives、MIGA in Japan）**、**Accountability（Integrity、Annual Reports）**、**Projects** 与 **Get Coverage**；并实测存在**逐项担保项目页**（如 Almaty Railway Bypass、Al Ahli Bank Kuwait-Egypt Capital Optimization）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「主权与政治风险的实际承保方」**——池内此前**有主权风险池（[[seadrif]]）、有行业组织（[[berne-union]]）、有官方出口信用（同轮 [[credendo]]）**，**但「多边机构自己开出什么担保」这一层没有**；**MIGA 的产品清单本身就是一份政治风险产品的完整分类法**（**违约、汇兑限制、战争内乱属政治风险；不履行公共债务属主权信用；信用证保兑属贸易融资**）——**对做主权风险与跨境项目融资的学生，这是一个可直接引用的产品框架**。**② ⭐ 「资本优化（Capital Optimization）」与「重大风险转移（Significant Risk Transfer）」两个产品值得单独注意**——**这两类不是传统「保损失」，而是「帮银行释放资本」**；**与池内 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 的偿付能力资本口径并读，可以看出「保险与担保如何被用作资本工具」这一前沿用法**（**注意：本次只读到产品名，未打开产品条款正文**）。**③ 「担保项目库」是现成的项目级一手材料**——**实测存在逐项项目页**，**对做案例研究（哪个国家、哪个行业、什么风险被担保）是直接可用的**；可与 [[worldbank-data]] 的宏观数据、[[imf-data]] 并读——**一个给宏观、一个给项目级**。**④ 与 [[berne-union]] 的分工很清楚**：**伯尔尼联盟是「行业的统计与立场」，MIGA 是「自己承保并公布项目」**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**三个页面的存在、标题、体量、首页体量、导航逐字实测的完整产品分类、站点结构区块与项目页的存在**，**但未打开任何产品条款正文、任何项目页内容、任何年报或「Reports and Resources」的具体文件**，因此**不能转述承保金额、费率、免责条款、项目细节或任何担保业务量**；**② 「担保项目库」本次仅核实到项目页 URL 形态存在（在首页链接中出现）**，**未验证其是否可按国家/行业/风险类型检索**；**③ 产品分类的完整性（是否还有其他产品）本次未核实**——**所述分类来自导航逐字实测**；**④ 「资本优化」与「重大风险转移」的产品含义本次仅为依据产品名的推断，未打开任何说明**（**故词条内该处已写明为阅读提示**）；**⑤ MIGA 的资本规模、成员国数量与成立年份本次未核实**；**⑥ 站点有 `Get Coverage` 与 `Log In` 入口，本次未登录，故未核实非公开内容范围**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** MIGA 提供精算工具或模型**。**核实说明**：`/all-guarantees`（109.2KB）、`/product/non-honoring-public-debt`（93.3KB）、`/annual-reports`（89.0KB）与首页（106.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航；**未打开产品条款、项目页内容、年报或资源文件**。
e.body_en:
**MIGA (the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency)** is **a member of the World Bank Group**, with a measured site title of **"World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA"**. After being explicitly put on the books in rounds 307 and 308, this entry is that commitment honoured, adding the **"actual underwriter of political and sovereign credit risk"** form — **the "political risk" form measured zero at title and summary level** (the closest item is [[berne-union]] from round 307, **but that is a trade body and its statistics, not an underwriter**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"All Guarantees" page `/all-guarantees` measures 109.2KB with the title "All Guarantees | World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA"**; ⭐ the **"Non-honoring of Public Debt" product page measures 93.3KB**; the **"Annual Reports" page measures 89.0KB**; the homepage measures 106.2KB. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the complete product classification**: under **POLITICAL RISK GUARANTEES** — **Breach of Contract**, **Currency Inconvertibility and Transfer Restriction**, **Capital Optimization**, ⭐ **War and Civil Disturbances**, **Project-Based Loan Guarantees for Private Sector Borrowers** and **Project-Based Payment Guarantee for the Private Sector**; under **TRADE FINANCE GUARANTEES** — **Letter of Credit Confirmation** and **Trade Loans**; under **CREDIT GUARANTEES** — ⭐ **Non-honoring of Public Debt**, **Partial/Full Credit Guarantees for Loan**, **Partial Credit Guarantees for Bonds**, **Unfunded Risk Participation**, **Risk-Sharing Facility** and **Significant Risk Transfer**. **Measured site structure** also includes **About (with Reports and Resources, History, MIGA Convention)**, **Partnerships (DFIs and MDBs, Trust Fund Facilities, Government Partnerships, Global Platforms & Initiatives, MIGA in Japan)**, **Accountability (Integrity, Annual Reports)**, **Projects** and **Get Coverage**; **individual guarantee project pages** measurably exist (such as Almaty Railway Bypass and Al Ahli Bank Kuwait-Egypt Capital Optimization).

For RIAA: **① it adds the actual underwriter of sovereign and political risk** — the corpus previously had **sovereign risk pools ([[seadrif]]), a trade body ([[berne-union]]) and official export credit ([[credendo]] in the same round)**, **but no layer for what a multilateral institution itself guarantees**; **MIGA’s product list is itself a complete taxonomy of political risk products** (**breach of contract, currency restriction and war/civil disturbance are political risk; non-honoring of public debt is sovereign credit; letter of credit confirmation is trade finance**) — **a directly citable product framework for students working on sovereign risk and cross-border project finance**. **② ⭐ "Capital Optimization" and "Significant Risk Transfer" deserve separate note** — **these two are not traditional "insure the loss" products but instruments that free up a bank’s capital**; **read with the solvency-capital material in [[insurance-scr-data]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[sii-equity-risk-scr]], they show how insurance and guarantees are used as capital tools** (**note: this check read only product names, not product terms**). **③ The guarantee/project database is ready-made project-level primary material** — **individual project pages measurably exist**, **directly usable for case studies (which country, which sector, what risk was guaranteed)**; readable with the macro data of [[worldbank-data]] and [[imf-data]] — **one provides macro, the other project level**. **④ The division of labour with [[berne-union]] is clear**: **the Berne Union is the industry’s statistics and positions; MIGA underwrites itself and publishes the projects**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the homepage size, the complete product classification read verbatim from navigation, the site structure blocks, and the existence of project pages**, **but opened no product terms, no project page content, no annual report and no specific file in "Reports and Resources"**, so **no guaranteed amount, premium rate, exclusion clause, project detail or business volume can be restated**; **② the "guarantee database" was verified only as the existence of project-page URL forms (appearing among homepage links)**, **not whether it is searchable by country, sector or risk type**; **③ the completeness of the product classification was not verified** — **the classification given comes from navigation read verbatim**; **④ the meaning of "Capital Optimization" and "Significant Risk Transfer" is inferred from the product names, with no description opened** (**so that passage in the entry is flagged as a reading prompt**); **⑤ MIGA’s capital size, member country count and founding year were not verified**; **⑥ the site has `Get Coverage` and `Log In` entry points and this check did not log in, so non-public content was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim MIGA provides actuarial tools or models**. **Verification note**: `/all-guarantees` (109.2KB), `/product/non-honoring-public-debt` (93.3KB), `/annual-reports` (89.0KB) and the homepage (106.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with navigation read verbatim; **no product terms, project page content, annual report or resource file was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**MIGA（Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency，多邊投資擔保機構）** 是**世界銀行集團成員**，站點標題實測 **「World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA」**。本條目是**第 307、308 兩輪明確記賬後兌現的主條**，補的是**「政治風險與主權信用風險的實際承保方」這一形態**——**實測池內「政治風險」在標題與摘要層面為 0**（最接近的是 307 輪剛收的 [[berne-union]]，**但那是行業組織與統計，不是承保機構**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「All Guarantees」頁 109.2KB**；⭐ **「Non-honoring of Public Debt」產品頁 93.3KB**；**「Annual Reports」頁 89.0KB**；首頁 106.2KB。**導航逐字實測的完整產品分類**：**POLITICAL RISK GUARANTEES** 下含 **Breach of Contract／Currency Inconvertibility and Transfer Restriction／Capital Optimization／⭐War and Civil Disturbances／Project-Based Loan Guarantees for Private Sector Borrowers／Project-Based Payment Guarantee for the Private Sector**；**TRADE FINANCE GUARANTEES** 下含 **Letter of Credit Confirmation／Trade Loans**；**CREDIT GUARANTEES** 下含 ⭐**Non-honoring of Public Debt／Partial-Full Credit Guarantees for Loan／Partial Credit Guarantees for Bonds／Unfunded Risk Participation／Risk-Sharing Facility／Significant Risk Transfer**。站點結構另含 **About（含 Reports and Resources、History、MIGA Convention）／Partnerships（DFIs and MDBs、Trust Fund Facilities、Government Partnerships、Global Platforms & Initiatives）／Accountability（Integrity、Annual Reports）／Projects／Get Coverage**；並實測存在**逐項擔保項目頁**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「主權與政治風險的實際承保方」**——池內此前**有主權風險池（[[seadrif]]）、有行業組織（[[berne-union]]）、有官方出口信用（同輪 [[credendo]]）**，**但「多邊機構自己開出什麼擔保」這一層沒有**；**MIGA 的產品清單本身就是一份政治風險產品的完整分類法**（**違約、匯兌限制、戰爭內亂屬政治風險；不履行公共債務屬主權信用；信用證保兌屬貿易融資**）。**② ⭐ 「資本優化」與「重大風險轉移」兩個產品值得單獨注意**——**這兩類不是傳統「保損失」，而是「幫銀行釋放資本」**；可與池內 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 並讀（**注意：本次只讀到產品名，未打開產品條款**）。**③ 「擔保項目庫」是現成的項目級一手材料**；可與 [[worldbank-data]]、[[imf-data]] 並讀——**一個給宏觀、一個給項目級**。**④ 與 [[berne-union]] 的分工很清楚**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、首頁體量、導航逐字實測的完整產品分類、站點結構區塊與項目頁的存在**，**但未打開任何產品條款正文、任何項目頁內容、任何年報或資源文件**，故**不能轉述承保金額、費率、免責條款、項目細節或業務量**；**② 擔保項目庫本次僅核實到項目頁 URL 形態存在**，**未驗證其是否可按國家／行業／風險類型檢索**；**③ 產品分類完整性未核實**；**④ 「資本優化」與「重大風險轉移」的產品含義僅為依據產品名的推斷，未打開任何說明**（**詞條內已寫明為閱讀提示**）；**⑤ 資本規模、成員國數量與成立年份未核實**；**⑥ 有 `Get Coverage` 與 `Log In` 入口，本次未登入**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** MIGA 提供精算工具或模型**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航；**未打開產品條款、項目頁內容、年報或資源文件**。
